interview.name: Quinn
interview.answer: The repair drive time and location aren’t specified in the notes.

reflections: Quinn is the organizer and informal hub, coordinating logistics and spreading information to neighbors.
Pia is engaged but primarily focused on practical details like timing and drop-off instructions.
Nell benefits from clearer communication and is relying on Quinn to help fill in missing details.
Quinn is acting as the organizer and reliable point person, giving logistics, rallying neighbors, and following up consistently.
Pia, Nell, Tess, and Noah are responsive but need clear details and reminders before they can help effectively.
The group seems supportive and practical, with people willing to contribute once the plan, timing, and drop-off details are made explicit.
Quinn is the organizer who coordinates the repair drive, shares logistics, and asks others to spread the word.
Tess, Cleo, and Ira are supportive neighbors who help with monitoring supplies, handling drop-offs, and relaying information.
Noah is willing to help, but his participation is tentative and depends on remembering and being free on Saturday.
Quinn is the main organizer and liaison, coordinating details, spreading the word, and keeping everyone updated.
The group is responsive and cooperative, with multiple people offering specific help for the repair drive and related errands.
Clear logistics and timely follow-up matter here; people repeatedly ask for exact needs, timing, and status updates.
Quinn is the main organizer who keeps coordinating volunteers, spreading updates, and tracking what still needs to be done.
The others are supportive and responsive, offering help with the repair drive and asking for details so they can stay involved.
The group’s communication is practical and collaborative, focused on sharing logistics, timing changes, and remaining repair tasks.

events.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia — the repair drive is this Saturday, and everyone’s welcome. If you want, I can save you a spot and send the details over.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Pia: That would help — can you send me the time and where to drop things off? I just want to make sure I’ve got the logistics right.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it starts at 10 a.m. at the community center, and you can drop items off at the side entrance.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: I’m thinking we should get the repair drive moving soon — I can spread the word to a few neighbors if you want.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Nell: That’d be great — I’ve mostly been hearing bits and pieces, so a little help spreading the word would really help.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell a few folks today and make sure they know the details.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell a few folks today and make sure they know the details.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a big help. I’ll let you know if they need extra hands or if the drop-off times change.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Noah: Oh yeah, thanks — just ping me when you’re heading over. I might make it if I remember.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details and give a few neighbors a heads-up today. If you remember, just swing by Saturday and bring anyone else who wants to help.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Noah: Sounds good — send me the details when you can, and I’ll try to remember Saturday. If I’m free, I might bring someone by too.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the supplies list open, and I’ll let you know if anything’s running low for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: Perfect — just send me a heads-up if anything’s running low, and I’ll spread it around to a few neighbors. The repair drive’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, with drop-off at the side entrance.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll keep watching the list and let you know right away if anything’s getting low.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: Great, thanks — I can do late morning. Just send me the exact list of any tools and replacement parts you still need, and I’ll plan from there.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know what I hear about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. If you hear anything, just pass it along and I’ll keep spreading the word.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can spread the word to a few neighbors and send them the details for Saturday. If you hear anything useful, let me know and I’ll keep everyone posted.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive too—just tell me the time and what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Quinn: Great — it starts Saturday morning, and we still need help with the fence, a leaky sink, and a couple of small fixes. I’ll send you the details and spread the word to the neighbors too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can spread the word to a few more neighbors and keep the repair drive moving. If you want, I can send the details and save a spot for anyone interested.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a big help. I’m still sorting out what’s needed, so please send the details and keep me in the loop.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll send the details around and keep everyone posted. Just let me know what else you need for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Yeah, it’s still happening—just moved to Sunday at the community center. What part do you need help with most?
events.speaker: Rey

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Quinn: I can spread the updated details to a few neighbors right away, and I can help save spots for anyone who wants to pitch in. What still needs the most hands on Sunday?

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Kira — that’s really helpful. Send it over when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep everything moving.
